Hayward, Wisconsin · eat

Restaurants in Hayward for cyclists

Where to eat in Hayward the night before a ride and the afternoon after. Nothing fancy. Real food, real portions, places that are open when you need them.

For: Chequamegon MTB Festival.

Restaurants in Hayward for cyclists, listed

  1. Angler's Bar & Grill

    Bar and grill, burgers, pizza, steak, Friday fish fry · 10547 Main Street, Hayward, WI 54843

    Middle of Main Street, a block from the race start.

  2. Angry Minnow Brewing Co.

    Brewpub · 10551 Main Street, Hayward, WI 54843

    House-brewed ales and pub food, Monday to Saturday 11 to 8, closed Sunday.

  3. Out of the Woods Winery

    Wine, cider and mead bar · 10588 Main Street, Hayward, WI 54843

    Bring your own food; the kitchen closes in summer. Closed Mondays.

  4. Backroads Coffee & Vibes Bakery

    Coffee, breakfast, lunch · Downtown Hayward, WI

    Pre-race coffee and breakfast on Main Street.

  5. Firehouse Bakery & Deli

    Bakery and deli · Downtown Hayward, WI

    Homemade bread, donuts and pastries for the ride out.
